```{r}
library(tidyverse)

library(gbm)

setwd("C:/Users/incik/OneDrive/Desktop/GT 25-26/Grand Challenges Group E4 System Component")

hurricaneData <- read_csv("StormDetailsClean.csv") %>% 
  as_tibble()

hurricaneData = dummy_cols(hurricaneData, select_columns = c("HLRR"), remove_first_dummy = TRUE)
#hurricaneData <- na.omit(hurricaneData)
#hurricaneData$logPriority <- log(hurricaneData$Priority)

hurricaneData <- hurricaneData[, sapply(hurricaneData, function(x) {
  is.atomic(x) && length(unique(x)) > 1
})]
hurricaneData
summary(hurricaneData)
```

**_Model Development_** \newline

**Random Forest**

```{r}
noConsideration <- c("STATE", "COUNTY", "NRI_ID", "SOVI_RATNG", "SOVI_SPCTL", 
                  "RESL_RATNG", "RESL_SPCTL", "RESL_VALUE", "EXPB", "EXPP", 
                  "EXPA", "EXP_AREA", "HLRR", "EALB", "EALP", "EALA", "EALS", 
                  "EALR", "ALRB", "ALRP", "ALRA", "ALR_NPCTL", "RISKV", "RISKR", 
                  "UniqueLocation")

restrictedData <- hurricaneData[, !(names(hurricaneData) %in% noConsideration)]

modelHurricaneRF1 <- ranger(
  dependent.variable.name = "Priority",
  data = restrictedData,
  num.trees = 500,
  importance = "impurity"
)

#summary(modelHurricaneRF1)

modelHurricaneRF1

attach(modelHurricaneRF1)

varImport <- variable.importance
sort(varImport, decreasing = TRUE)

detach()
```

```{r}
modelHurricaneRF2 <- ranger(
  formula = Priority ~ EXPPE + EXPT + POPULATION + BUILDVALUE,
  data = hurricaneData,
  num.trees = 500,
  importance = "impurity"
)

#summary(modelHurricaneRF2)

modelHurricaneRF2
```
```{r}
modelHurricaneG1 <- glm(
  Priority ~ . -STATE -COUNTY -NRI_ID -SOVI_RATNG -SOVI_SPCTL -RESL_RATNG -RESL_SPCTL -RESL_VALUE -EXPB -EXPP -EXPA -EXP_AREA -HLRR -EALB -EALP -EALA -EALS -EALR -ALRB -ALRP -ALRA -ALR_NPCTL -RISKV -RISKR -UniqueLocation,
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data = hurricaneData
)
modelHurricaneG1
summary(modelHurricaneG1)
```

```{r}
modelHurricaneG2 <- glm(
  Priority ~ POPULATION + AGRIVALUE + AREA + SOVI_SCORE + RESL_SCORE + EVNTS + AFREQ + HLRB + HLRP + HLRA + EALPE + EALT + RISKS + `HLRR_Relatively High` + `HLRR_Relatively Low` + `HLRR_Relatively Moderate` + `HLRR_Very High` + `HLRR_Very Low`,
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data = hurricaneData
)
#modelHurricaneG2
summary(modelHurricaneG2)
```
